title: Brevity
summary: BREV'ITY, noun [Latin brevitas, from brevis, short. See Brief.] 1. Shortness; applied to time; as the brevity of human life. 2. Shortness; conciseness; contraction into few words; applied to discourse

inlines.v: BREV'ITY, noun [Latin brevitas, from brevis, short. See Brief.] 1. Shortness; applied to time; as the brevity of human life. 2. Shortness; conciseness; contraction into few words; applied to discourses or writings.
